beats.html:
Debbie Reynolds was 66
when she played
Aggie Cromwell.

The witch everybody
remembers as the
fearless one was a
woman in her 60s.

She's 19. She has never
once been worried
about it.

19 years old, 10 of them mine.
15 pages of what actually
keeps her comfortable.
Free, and yours.

clip.match_reason: The fearless one is a small old girl in a bow, entirely sure of her place, and the human smiling down at her is the audience of the fact.
